scripts.kill-dev-ports: lsof -ti:3000 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; lsof -ti:3001 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; lsof -ti:3002 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; echo Done
scripts.build:staging: npx prisma generate && cd client && npm run build
scripts.build:prod: npx prisma generate && npx prisma migrate deploy && cd client && npm run build
scripts.build:prod:restart: npm run build:prod && sudo systemctl restart comictracker
scripts.db:check-drift: npx prisma db pull --preview && git diff --exit-code prisma/schema.prisma || echo 'Schema drift detected!'
scripts.db:reset-schema: npx prisma db pull && npx prisma generate
scripts.db:sync: npm run db:pull && npm run db:generate
